tool.name: set_breakpoint
tool.description: Set a BSL line breakpoint in a module (optionally with a condition expression)

tool.name: list_breakpoints
tool.description: List all BSL line breakpoints currently set in the workspace

tool.name: remove_breakpoint
tool.description: Remove a BSL line breakpoint by breakpointId (no-op if it no longer exists)

tool.name: get_stack
tool.description: Get the call stack of a thread in a suspended debug session

tool.name: list_debug_sessions
tool.description: List active debug sessions (debugSessionId, state, infobase, clientType, startedAt)

tool.name: get_debug_state
tool.description: Get the current state (running / suspended / terminated) of a debug session

tool.name: debug_resume
tool.description: Resume a debug session; blocks until the next stop (breakpoint / termination) or timeoutSeconds elapses

tool.name: debug_pause
tool.description: Suspend a running debug session; returns the resulting state (suspended, running if it timed out, or terminated)

tool.name: debug_step
tool.description: Step a thread in a suspended debug session (over / into / out); blocks until the step completes or timeoutSeconds elapses

tool.name: debug_client
tool.description: Launch a 1С thin or thick client under the debugger and attach a debug session

tool.name: stop_debug
tool.description: Terminate a debug session by debugSessionId (no-op if it is already gone)

tool.name: get_variables
tool.description: Get the variables of a frame in a suspended debug session (name, type, value)

tool.name: evaluate
tool.description: Evaluate a BSL expression in a frame of a suspended debug session

tool.name: set_variable
tool.description: Set the value of a BSL variable in a frame of a suspended debug session (via assignment statement)
